findings.taint_path: Authorization header (or other token sources) → Split by '-' to get parts[0] (token key) and parts[1] (channel ID) → c.Set("specific_channel_id", parts[1])
findings.potential_interaction: A token like 'sk-<token>-<channel-id>' could set a specific_channel_id if the user is admin, which might be used elsewhere without validation
